example: Giving up your seat to an older person seems to be a thing of the past.
現在好像很少人給老人讓座了。

NONE: 一些事情；些許知識，一星半點

example: I'm having trouble paying attention - I have a thing or two on my mind.
我現在很難集中注意力——我心裡有事。
Why don't you ask Andrew about it? He knows a thing or two about (= has some knowledge of) computers.
這個問題為甚麼不問問安德魯？他懂點電腦。
She thinks she knows everything about raising children, but I could tell her a thing or two (= some information she does not know).
她覺得自己對於養育孩子樣樣精通，不過我倒可以讓她見識一二。

NONE: › a period when you experience a lot of problems
› someone who is very unpleasant and difficult to deal with
討厭的傢夥；難對付的人

example: As a teenager, Jack was a real hard nut, always getting into fights.
十幾歲的傑克很難管教，總是跟人打架。

NONE: › a person who gives you help and support when you are in a difficult situation

example: Andrea was a tower of strength to me when I was ill.
我生病時，安德莉婭就是我的精神支柱。
To prevent red wine from staining, put some salt on it - it works a treat.
要想不讓紅葡萄酒留下汙漬，在汙漬處灑些鹽——效果很不錯。
That soup went down a treat (= tasted very good)!
那湯很好喝！
I polished that old desk of grandma's and it came up a treat (= its appearance improved).
我把奶奶的那張舊書桌擦了擦，馬上就煥然一新。

NONE: › an action that makes a bad situation worse, especially one that forces someone to do something

example: Each letter from my bank is another turn of the screw.
銀行的每一封來信都給我帶來更大壓力。

NONE: › an occasion when a large group of family or friends meet, especially in order to enjoy themselves
